npcdefault.htm.text: I have nothing to say to you

ai/npc/Teleports/NewbieGuide/30598-001.h.text: Newbie Guide: Visit me whenever you need advice! I'll help you as much as I can.

links.text: Ask about teleporting to Newbie Town.
Check the list of available Support Magic.
Get support with a Newbie item.

ai/npc/Teleports/NewbieGuide/30598-002.h.text: Newbie Guide: You are no longer a novice, my friend. You have outgrown my help. Good day to you, and continued good fortune.

ai/npc/Teleports/NewbieGuide/30598-003.h.text: Newbie Guide: Greetings, friend. I seldom meet your folk here in the Talking Island village. It is my task to guide novices, but I advise only Humans. I'm sure that there is a guide of your own race in your home.

ai/npc/Teleports/NewbieGuide/30598-04.ht.text: Newbie Guide: Which of the following best describes the one you seek?

ai/npc/Teleports/NewbieGuide/30598-04a.h.text: Newbie Guide: Select the one you seek below. Their location will be indicated on the radar.

ai/npc/Teleports/NewbieGuide/30598-05.ht.text: Newbie Guide: If you want to meet the person you seek, move in the direction of the arrow.

ai/npc/Teleports/NewbieGuide/30598-f05-0.text: Newbie Guide: Its never too early to think about your long-term goals. The Kingdom of Aden is in chaos, because they are at war with Elmore to the north and Gracia across the sea. Remember, there are always opportunities during times of chaos. Now you are merely a novice Fighter, but if you train h…

Newbie Guide: I suppose you're using the weapons and armor you were issued. That's unless you have rich friends, of course, eh? Whatever you have is fine for now. Remember to pay attention to what you find while hunting monsters -- you can find armor, and sometimes even weapons, in the wild. If you…

Newbie Guide: Begin by hunting keltirs , elder keltirs or wolves near the village. The wolves are the more dangerous, so take care. When you target a monster, the monster's name appears in the upper central portion of the screen. The color of the name tells you the monster's difficulty . For now, h…

Newbie Guide: You can begin to learn skills when you reach level 5. You will receive instruction in new skills from the Masters of the Warriors Guild. The guildhall lies to the east, near the tower at the crossroads in the center of the village. Now, pay attention; you'll need SP to gain your skill…

links.text: I want to know more about skills.

ai/npc/Teleports/NewbieGuide/30598-f05-0.text: Newbie Guide: If you use your head while hunting, you should have about 60 SP by the time you reach level 5. Master Pintage or Master Gwinter can tell you the skills in which you can train. Skills are divided into active skills and passive skills. Active skills require that you intentionally use th…

Newbie Guide: Several of the villagers here could use your help. Talk to them and click on Quest to see what missions they have to offer. Of course, even if they're looking for help they're not going to offer you a mission that's beyond your capabilities. If they refuse to offer you anything, it me…

Newbie Guide: I'll tell you about all the quests I know of, but I don't know about them all. You should talk to all the villagers you can. First, you see this young fellow here next to me? His name is Darin , and he seems to be worried about something. Why don't you see if he could use your help? H…

ai/npc/Teleports/NewbieGuide/30598-f05.h.text: Newbie Guide: What do you wish to discuss? I'm sure there's much you wish to learn.

links.text: What is the best equipment for me?
What is the best hunting site for me?
Which quests are available to me?

ai/npc/Teleports/NewbieGuide/30598-f10-0.text: Newbie Guide: Now I believe you're ready to explore more of this island, if all you've done so far is adventure around the village. Explore the north and south sides of the island. Grand Master Roien will have some important quests for you when you reach level 9 or so, but we'll talk more about tha…

Newbie Guide: At level 6, your most important task is to find better weapons. Consider the weapon you are wielding now, then think how you wish to improve it. If a dagger is your choice, seek to obtain a Bone Dagger . A Doom Dagger is even better, but will be quite expensive. A Bone Dagger will do.…

links.text: I want to know about the characteristics of each weapon type.
I want to know about armor.

ai/npc/Teleports/NewbieGuide/30598-f10-0.text: Newbie Guide: Weapons are divided into seven classes. They are: swords, blunt weapons, two-handed blunt weapons and two-handed swords, daggers, polearms, fists, and bows. I can teach you about swords, blunt weapons, daggers and bows.

Newbie Guide: One-handed swords are the most common weapons. Their abilities are well balanced in every way. The Squire's Sword you began your adventures with was one of these. If you are unsure which weapon would be best for you, a one-handed sword is always a suitable choice. You may use the Powe…

Newbie Guide: One-handed blunt weapons have a higher accuracy than other weapons. However, their chance to inflict critical damage is much lower. Blunt weapons are designed to reliably deal predictable amounts of damage. I recommend these weapons to Mystics, who do not have the training to be highl…

Newbie Guide: Two-handed swords and two-handed blunt weapons tell the world that a warrior possesses formidable power. It stands to reason that wielding your weapon with both arms would deal more powerful strokes, and also extend the weapon's reach. The drawback is that a two-handed weapon's attack…

Newbie Guide: Dagger type weapons allow you to attack with unsurpassed speed. Furthermore, they have the greatest chance of inflicting critical damage. Their accuracy is low, however, and of course their reach is quite short. Daggers also have a very small range of random damage. However, in combin…

Newbie Guide: Obviously, the advantage of bows is their ability to deliver damage at range. There is more, though, that you should know. Bows are the slowest weapons, but they can inflict the greatest damage. A popular tactic is to open combat with a Power Shot, before you close to attack with your…

Newbie Guide: If you've accomplished all that Lector's asked of you, you should be doing well for armor. Nonetheless, you may wish to save your Adena to upgrade your armor piece by piece. If you've reached level 6, you can wear Apprentice's Shoes, Cloth Caps and Short Gloves with your armor. If you…

Newbie Guide: I think you'll do well to hunt orcs, werewolves, and goblins . First, to find orcs, just follow the seashore from your former hunting grounds, and head northwest. Or exit the village by the northern gate and travel west to the circle of standing stones we call the Elven Ruins. Before …

Newbie Guide: Have you gained a combat skill yet? You'll recall I advised either Power Strike or Mortal Blow, depending on your choice of weapon. There's no need to learn both. As a rule, novices acquire an attack skill first, and then learn Relax , a healing skill. After that, they learn passive s…

Newbie Guide: Good reports have been reaching my ears of the way you've been helping the other villagers. It makes me feel quite honored to be your teacher. One of your most important tasks is approaching. When you reach level 9, visit Grand Master Roien in Sedrick's Training Hall. He will tell you…

links.text: I want to know more about quests.

ai/npc/Teleports/NewbieGuide/30598-f10-0.text: Newbie Guide: Captain Gilbert recently received a message from the Lord of Gludio by way of Sir Windawood, I understand. I believe he could use your assistance. And there's that master of yours with the odd... that is, unique... hobby of collecting novel weapons -- I speak of Master Minia . She's i…

ai/npc/Teleports/NewbieGuide/30598-f10.h.text: Newbie Guide: My word, you've made progress all right! But so far you haven't had to use your head much at all -- from now on, you'll need to think and plan if you want to survive. In particular, I want you to think about your equipment and skills. I want you to ask me questions now, and remember t…

links.text: What is the best equipment for me?
What is the best hunting site for me?
Which quests are available to me?

ai/npc/Teleports/NewbieGuide/30598-f15-0.text: Newbie Guide: You want to know why you're at a turning point? Ha, I'll tell you why. Around level 18 or 19 you'll have to choose the next step in your professional path, but if you're going to be ready to make that choice you have to start preparing right now. The most important thing for you to le…

links.text: I want to know about fighting in groups.

ai/npc/Teleports/NewbieGuide/30598-f15-0.text: Newbie Guide: It is time to talk about forming a party , a group of adventurers to hunt and travel with. Parties make it easier to survive in the wilderness, and allow you to gain experience faster. Parties are created using Invite in the Action tab ( ALT + C ) of your Character Status window. Firs…

links.text: I want to fight on my own.
I want to fight in groups.

ai/npc/Teleports/NewbieGuide/30598-f15-0.text: Newbie Guide: I see. You have chosen a difficult path, though it does have its rewards. If you wish to hunt solo, there are several things you should know. First, there's the matter of timing your battles while on the hunt. As you increase in level, you will need more and more time to rest between …

Newbie Guide: It requires serious preparation to be an effective part of a group. Experience is the best teacher, but I can tell you some of the basics. First, for now it matters little whether you hunt with other Fighters or with Mystics. The most important thing right now is that you find people …

Newbie Guide: A Sword of Solidarity or a broadsword are good enough until you reach level 12, but, after that you will need something with more attack power. To obtain the best weapons for yourself, you should seek out other adventurers willing to trade. You can buy weapons in stores, of course, bu…

links.text: I want to hear about weapons.
I want to hear about armor.
I want to hear about items.

ai/npc/Teleports/NewbieGuide/30598-f15-0.text: Newbie Guide: Have you considered the next weapon you wish to purchase? A broadsword is just a child's toy to you now. At level 12 or 13 the Gladius is an excellent choice for a sword, the dirk for a dagger, and the Dwarven Mace for a blunt weapon. You can find these weapons in stores, but they are…

Newbie Guide: At your current level, a Wooden Breastplate and a Hard Leather Pants set are an effective combination. Leather Shoes, a Wooden Helmet and gloves should be sought to complete your set. Of course, you will not be able to equip all this equipment immediately at level 11, but you can star…

Newbie Guide: It's time for you to learn about magic items. I'm sure that by now you've used Lesser Healing Potions, but there's far more that you must know about if you plan to succeed. It is time that you began to acquire accessories . This is the general term for items that increase your magic d…

Newbie Guide: Fighters around your level usually have good luck near the Obelisk of Victory in the middle of the island. The stretch to the west of the obelisk is an especially good hunting ground, with plenty of orcs and werewolves. That's the perfect place to fulfill Captain Gilbert's mission. If…

Newbie Guide: We need to talk about how to apply your skills in battle. I'm going to explain about disrupting magic . You may have already seen stone golems give up on casting a spell when they take damage while casting. Well, it's not just stone golems who do that, it applies to every monster that…

Newbie Guide: So which quests are you ready for now? You've grown strong enough that it would be a pity to waste your talents on trivial tasks. Ah, of course -- Elias , near here, is worried. I hear that his students at the magic school are suffering from some unknown fever. Perhaps you can be of s…

ai/npc/Teleports/NewbieGuide/30598-f15.h.text: Newbie Guide: You've grown since we first met. I can hardly recognize you. It's time to begin a new phase of your training now. You must focus on learning about cooperating with other adventurers . This is a turning point for you. Before you reached level 10, all you had to do to succeed was obey m…

links.text: What is the best equipment for me?
What is the best hunting site for me?
Which quests are available to me?

ai/npc/Teleports/NewbieGuide/30598-f20-0.text: Newbie Guide: I've told you this before, but the choice of your professional path is very important. The whole course of your future will be based on the path you choose. If you want me to, I can tell you more about the occupations available to you.

links.text: I want to know about the occupations available to me.
I want to know how to refine professions.

ai/npc/Teleports/NewbieGuide/30598-f20-0.text: Newbie Guide: As a Human Fighter, you can choose Warrior , Human Knight or Rogue as your next profession. Whichever you choose, you'll have to leave this island and go to Aden for further training. You should speak to the Grand Master for more information. He'll examine your qualifications and advi…

Newbie Guide: To refine your profession, you must leave Talking Island for Gludin , the port city of Aden. As a Fighter, the time has come for you to face the dangers of the wide world. If you want to know more about the transition, you must visit the Fighters Guild and speak to Grand Master Bitz. …

Newbie Guide: We don't have a great deal of time left to teach you about items. I'll explain as much as I can in the time that remains. Some of the information may seem complex, but you must comprehend it if you are to take the best professional path for yourself. Where shall we begin?

links.text: I want to know about recommended weapons and armor.

ai/npc/Teleports/NewbieGuide/30598-f20-0.text: Newbie Guide: If you have chosen to wield a one-handed sword, then by now you may possess a long sword . If luck has been with you, you may have acquired a Sword of Reflection or a Sword of Watershadow . Both are quite similar to a long sword, so either will suit your purposes. A Shining Knife is a…

Newbie Guide: Upper and lower body armor is classified as either robes , light gear or heavy gear . Robes are for Mystics and that ilk, so we'll skip them and move directly to light and heavy gear. When you select a profession at level 20, the armor you wear will influence your choice of skills. Fo…

Newbie Guide: Have you encountered soulshot yet in your adventures? It is a form of magical ammunition created by the Dwarves. You can use it like a potion while engaged in armed combat. It allows you to inflict greater damage, but it disappears when used. Around level 15 you will be able to acquir…

Newbie Guide: By their arts, Dwarven craftsmen can crystallize certain substances into Leaguam, Ravi, Ciel and Arch, through a process they call the "Crystallization Ritual." These craftsmen have assigned grades to every substance in the world, according to the types of crystal they form during the…

Newbie Guide: By now, you're able to hunt anywhere on the island. I imagine spiders are your usual prey. There are plenty of spiders on the northern side of the island and on the mountain. If you're in the mood for something different and more dangerous, you can try the Elven Ruins . For a long tim…

Newbie Guide: Look, until you refine your profession, there's nothing more for you to learn. There are no new skills that you can be taught until you take the next step on your prefessional path at level 20. I'll give you a piece of advice for when you take that step. If you decide to be a Knight, …

Newbie Guide: All right, let me think ... you say you're hunting spiders? Then you've probably already spoken to Elias . If not, visit him. Your conversation could be profitable. If you're planning to venture into the Elven Ruins, you should meet Trader Katerina of the item store. I heard she is se…

ai/npc/Teleports/NewbieGuide/30598-f20.h.text: Newbie Guide: There's little more for you to learn here on the island. The thing to be thinking about now is the next step in your professional path. Will you be a Warrior, with a powerful offense, a Knight who balances offense and defensive strength, or a Rogue, with a unique hunting style using b…

ai/npc/Teleports/NewbieGuide/30598-m07-0.text: Newbie Guide: It's never too early to think about your long-term goals. The Kingdom of Aden is in chaos, because they are at war with Elmore to the north and Gracia across the sea. Remember, there are always opportunities during times of chaos . Now you are merely a novice Mystic, but if you train …

Newbie Guide: Your apprentice's staff is effective until level 5 or so. Try to save around 1,000 Adena by then, so you can purchase an Apprentice's Rod . You can make use of the armor you obtain from monsters, of course, but this depends entirely on luck. If you reached level 5 and you do not yet h…

Newbie Guide: Listen closely, this is very important knowledge for a Mystic like yourself. Armor is divided into robes, light armor and heavy armor. Mystics may wear armor of any type, but different types of armor will affect your abilities differently. When I refer to a set of armor, it means that…

Newbie Guide: Start out by hunting elder keltirs or wolves near the village and magic school. Since your spells are where your power lies, look for monsters you can defeat with a single spell until you reach level 3 or so. When you make it to level 6, you should leave the village by the western gat…

links.text: How do you determine a monster's strength?

ai/npc/Teleports/NewbieGuide/30598-m07-0.text: Newbie Guide: When you target a monster, the monster's name appears in the upper central portion of the screen. The color of the name tells you the monster's difficulty . Those that appear in white or sky blue have abilities equal to or less than yours, while those that appear in red or yellow are …

Newbie Guide: A Mystic must pay close attention to both current HP and current MP. Make sure you have enough of both before entering combat. If either value is dangerously low, use the Sit mode from the Action tab of your Character Status window to rest between combats.

Newbie Guide: When you reach level 7, you will learn new magic. Seek instruction from the Magisters of the Temple of Einhasad. The Temple of Einhasad is the largest building in the village, located on the south side of town. You have probably noticed by now that when you defeat monsters you gain SP…

links.text: Tell me more about learning magic.
What magic should I learn first?

ai/npc/Teleports/NewbieGuide/30598-m07-0.text: Newbie Guide: Learning magic is an ongoing process. As you practice what you've learned, you will continue to advance and earn SP. So, if you learn Wind Strike now, you will be able to cast Wind Strike level 2. Then, once you've earned 240 SP, you may use it to learn Wind Strike again, and thus be …

Newbie Guide: I recommend that you train the Wind Strike spell to level 2 by the time you reach level 7. At that point, if you have enough SP, you should raise it all the way to level 3. If Wind Strike doesn't suit you for some reason, consider a level 1 Ice Bolt. This spell will slow your target's…

Newbie Guide: There are plenty of folk here in the village who could use your help. Talk to them and they might offer you an assignment when you click on Quest . I will tell you of all the quests I know of for Mystics of your level, but there may be others that I have not heard of. Speak to the oth…

links.text: I want to know more about the quests.

ai/npc/Teleports/NewbieGuide/30598-m07-0.text: Newbie Guide: I'll tell you about all the quests I know of, but I don't know about them all. You should talk to all the villagers you can. First, you see this young fellow here next to me? His name is Darin , and he seems to be worried about something. Why don't you see if he could use your help? H…

ai/npc/Teleports/NewbieGuide/30598-m07.h.text: Newbie Guide: What do you wish to learn first? A novice like yourself needs to know plenty. Listen to what I have to tell you.

links.text: What is the best equipment for me?
What is the best hunting site for me?
Which quests are available to me?

ai/npc/Teleports/NewbieGuide/30598-m14-0.text: Newbie Guide: Now you are ready to venture beyond the immediate vicinity of the village, and begin to explore the rest of the island. Speak to Grand Master Roien at level 9 or so, for he has an important quest for you. Don't let your masters down now -- explore the island, learn your spells and pra…

links.text: I want to hunt with others.

ai/npc/Teleports/NewbieGuide/30598-m14-0.text: Newbie Guide: I see. You have chosen a difficult path, though it does have its rewards. If you wish to hunt solo, there are things you need to know. First, there's the matter of timing your battles while on the hunt. As you increase in level, you will need more and more time to rest between battles…

Newbie Guide: It requires serious preparation to be an effective part of a group. Experience is the best teacher, but I can tell you some of the basics. First, for now it matters little whether you hunt with Fighters or with other Mystics. The most important thing right now is that you find people …

Newbie Guide: As soon as you save enough money, you should buy an Apprentice's Spellbook . Check the Chat and Trade windows regularly ... the best way to find quality items at a reasonable price is to buy them from other adventurers. If you completed Captain Gilbert's quest at level 6, you might ha…

links.text: I want to know about the characteristics of each weapon type

ai/npc/Teleports/NewbieGuide/30598-m14-0.text: Newbie Guide: Weapons are classified into seven categories. They are: one-handed swords, blunt weapons, two-handed swords and two-handed blunt weapons, daggers, polearms, fists and bows. Your staff is considered a blunt weapon. I can offer you guidance about swords, blunt weapons, daggers and bows,…

links.text: Difference between Mystic Weapons and Fighter Weapons

ai/npc/Teleports/NewbieGuide/30598-m14-0.text: Newbie Guide: You've probably noticed that Mystic and Fighter weapons are sold separately. Even if they seem to be of the same type, there are subtle differences. Fighter weapons cause heavy damage but possess low magic attack power, while with Mystic weapons the ratio is reversed. However, Fighter…

Newbie Guide: One-handed swords are the most common weapons. They are well-balanced in all their attributes. Mystics with a taste for hand-to-hand combat often carry swords and shields. This combination is particularly useful in solo hunting.

Newbie Guide: One-handed blunt weapons have a higher accuracy than other weapons. However, their chance to inflict critical damage is much lower. Blunt weapons are designed to reliably deal predictable amounts of damage . This is the reason they are the first weapons a Mystic learns. As you advance…

Newbie Guide: Two-handed blunts weapons and two-handed swords send a message of formidable power. Two-handed blunt weapons like the Cedar Staff -- a popular weapon among Mystics -- have a relatively slow swing, but can inflict damage nearly as great as a well-armed Fighter. They also have excellent…

Newbie Guide: Dagger type weapons allow you to attack with unsurpassed speed. Furthermore, they have the greatest chance of inflicting critical damage. Their accuracy is low, however, and of course their reach is quite short. Daggers also have a very small range of random damage.

Newbie Guide: Obviously, the advantage of bows is their ability to deliver damage at range. There is more, though, that you should know. Bows are the slowest weapons, but they can inflict the greatest damage. Most use their bows as a backup weapon.

Newbie Guide: What do you do with your old weapons when you buy new ones? Do you sell them to a store? You might get a better price if you sell them to other adventurers. You can often buy gear for a better price from other adventurers as well. Press the Trade tab on the bottom left of the Chat win…

Newbie Guide: Have you heard of the Obelisk of Victory ? Travel north from town for a little while, then head west until you see a tower. Created by the Elves and called the Obelisk of Victory, it's considered a good place to hunt for anyone past level 7. For someone of your level, focus on battlin…

Newbie Guide: Your abilities are increasing well enough. I can now tell you which skills you should improve first. But before I can advise you, I must know whether you have chosen to concentrate your energies on fighting alone, or as a member of a party. Which is your choice?

Newbie Guide: In party play, Fighters have the job of standing face to face with the enemy. You can hurl attack spells, but it is equally important for you to support the Fighters with healing and strengthening spells. To effectively support Fighters in combat, make sure you have Heal to at least l…

Newbie Guide: In solo play, you will need to do ever more damage as you advance in level. Therefore, it is important to regularly enhance the power of Wind Strike , which is your best attack spell. Defense is equally vital in solo play, so you should also learn Armor Mastery and Magic Defense . In …

Newbie Guide: Many of the villagers could use your help, and there are plenty of quests out there for your level. They can be an excellent boost to your training. Now Master Minia of the Fighter Guild is a very strange ... that is to say, a unique person. She has this hobby of collecting unique wea…

ai/npc/Teleports/NewbieGuide/30598-m14.h.text: Newbie Guide: My word, I must say you've been doing well enough so far. However, you have not yet been called upon to use your brain a great deal. From now on it will take wisdom and cunning to survive. In particular, you must make wise choices when it comes to your equipment and skills. Pay attent…

ai/npc/Teleports/NewbieGuide/30598-m20-0.text: Newbie Guide: I've told you this before, but I'll repeat myself now -- the choice of your next professional step is very important. The whole course of your future will be based on the path you choose. You can choose between being a Human Wizard and a Cleric . If you want to know more about these p…

Newbie Guide: By level 16, if you have been fortunate you may have acquired an apprentice's staff . Even if luck has eluded you so far, you should have enough Adena to purchase one by level 18. If you are wearing Stockings of Devotion and a Tunic of Devotion at level 17, you are in excellent shape.…

Newbie Guide: Have you ever heard of an item called a spiritshot while you were hunting? Or have you ever wondered about what a spiritshot is while reading the detailed information about a weapon? A spiritshot is an item that increases your magic attack. Directions for usage are identical to soulsh…

Newbie Guide: By their arts, Dwarven craftsmen can crystallize certain substances into Leaguam, Ravi, Ciel and Arch, through a process they call the "Crystallization Ritual." These craftsmen have assigned grades to every substance in the world, according to the types of crystal they form during the…

Newbie Guide: At your level, you can hunt anywhere on this island. The spider would probably be the best quarry. There are many spiders living along the road that begins at the northern mountain and runs south close to the shore line. If you want to try a more difficult location, visit the Elven Ru…

Newbie Guide: Look, until you refine your profession, there's nothing more for you to learn. There are no new skills that you can be taught until you take your next professional step at level 20. If you decide to be a Human Wizard, you can Summon Kat the Cat, or use powerful magic like Flame Strike…

Newbie Guide: All right, let me think ... you say you're hunting spiders? Then you've probably already spoken to Elias . If not, visit him. Your conversation could be profitable. Also, if you're planning to venture into the Elven Ruins, you should meet Trader Katerina of the item store. I heard she…

ai/npc/Teleports/NewbieGuide/30598-m20.h.text: Newbie Guide: There's little more for you to learn here on the island. The thing to be considering now is the next step in your professional path. Will you be a Human Wizard , with powerful offensive spells, or a Cleric , with potent healing magic?

ai/npc/Teleports/NewbieGuide/pk-protecti.text: Newbie Guide: The Blessing of Protection is available to characters under level 39 who have not completed their second class transfer. Protected by its power, you cannot receive damage from (or inflict damage to) chaotic characters who are 10+ levels above you. It will not protect you on the battle…

ai/npc/Teleports/NewbieGuide/newbie-toke.text: Newbie Guide: Newbie Guides offer teleportation between Newbie Towns to any character below level 20. If you use this service, it is also possible to visit the starting village of another race through a Newbie Guide . But be careful how you use this advantage -- it is normal to learn a specific ski…

ai/npc/Teleports/NewbieGuide/buffs-playe.text: You are eligible to receive the following supplemental magic: Levels 6-75: Wind Walk Levels 6-75: Shield Levels 6-75: Magic Barrier Levels 6-75: Bless the Body (Fighter), Bless the Soul (Wizard) Levels 6-75: Vampiric Rage (Fighter), Acumen (Wizard) Levels 6-75: Regeneration (Fighter), Concentration…

ai/npc/Teleports/NewbieGuide/newbie-guid.text: Newbie Guide: To congratulate you on your achievements, the Adventure Guild is pleased to open its warehouse to both apprentice adventurers who have reached level 6 as well as to travelers who have completed their first class transfer. At level 6, you can use the Apprentice Adventurer's Weapon Exch…

links.text: Receive the Apprentice Adventurer's Weapon Exchange Coupon.
Receive the Adventurer's Magic Accessory Exchange Coupon.

ai/npc/Teleports/NewbieGuide/30599-m14-0.text: Newbie Guide: Now you are ready to venture beyond the immediate vicinity of the village, and begin to explore the deeper parts of the Elven Forest. Speak to Sentinel Kendell at level 10, and Sentinel Knight Alberius at level 12, for they will have important quests for you to accomplish. Now is also…

links.text: I want to hunt with others.

ai/npc/Teleports/NewbieGuide/30599-m14-0.text: Newbie Guide: I see. You have chosen a difficult path, though it does have its rewards. If you wish to hunt solo, there are things you need to know. First, there's the matter of timing your battles while on the hunt. As you increase in level, you will need more and more time to rest between battles…

Newbie Guide: It requires serious preparation to be an effective part of a group. Experience is the best teacher, but I can tell you some of the basics. First, for now it matters little whether you hunt with Fighters or with other Mystics. The most important thing is that you find people you trust …

ai/npc/Teleports/NewbieGuide/30599-m14.h.text: Newbie Guide: You have grown much. Your progress makes me proud. There are new things that I may teach you now, and when you reach level 15 I will teach you even more.

links.text: What is the best equipment for me?
What is the best hunting site for me?
Which quests are available to me?

ai/npc/Teleports/NewbieGuide/30599-m14-0.text: Newbie Guide: As soon as you save enough money, you should buy an Apprentice's Spellbook . Check the Chat and Trade windows regularly ... the best way to find quality items at a reasonble price is to buy them from other adventurers. If you complete the "Skirmish with the Orcs" quest at level 10, or…

links.text: I want to know about the characteristics of each weapon type.

ai/npc/Teleports/NewbieGuide/30599-m14-0.text: Newbie Guide: Take your Apprentice's Spellbook, or whatever you are using, and head southeast of the village to hunt Kaboo Orcs , or Kaboo Orc grunts until you are ready to improve your weapons. If you upgrade your weapons at level 9 or 10, you might venture farther to the southeast and cross the t…

Newbie Guide: Your skills increase at a satisfactory rate. I can now tell you which skills you should improve first. Before I can advise you however, I must know whether you have chosen to concentrate your energies on fighting alone, or as a member of a party. Which is your choice?

Newbie Guide: Many of the villagers are in need of your help, and the quests they offer can benefit you as well. Do not neglect to seek them out. Sentinel Kendell , at the southeast gate, is again recruiting warriors to battle against the Orc tribes that came to our lands from over the Misty Mounta…

Newbie Guide: Weapons are classified into seven categories. They are: one-handed swords, blunt weapons, two-handed swords and two-handed blunt weapons, daggers, polearms, fists and bows. Your staff is considered a blunt weapon. I can offer you guidance about swords, blunt weapons, daggers and bows,…

links.text: Difference between Mystic Weapons and Fighter Weapons

ai/npc/Teleports/NewbieGuide/30599-m14-0.text: Newbie Guide: What did you do with your old weapons when you bought new ones? Did you sell them to a merchant? You might have received a better price if you had sold them to other adventurers. You can often buy gear for a better price from other adventurers than from a store. Try clicking the Trade…

Newbie Guide: When fighting in a party, the Fighters have the job of standing face to face with the enemy. You can hurl attack spells, but it is equally important for you to support the Fighters with healing and strengthening spells. To effectively support Fighters in combat, make sure you have Hea…

Newbie Guide: In solo play, you will need to do ever more damage as you advance in level. Therefore, it is important to regularly enhance the power of Wind Strike , which is your best attack spell. Defense is just as vital in solo play, so you should also learn Armor Mastery and Magic Defense . In …

Newbie Guide: You've probably noticed that Mystic and Fighter weapons are sold separately. Even if they seem to be of the same type, there are subtle differences. Fighter weapons cause heavy damage but possess low magic attack power, while with Mystic weapons the ratio is reversed. However, Fighter…

Newbie Guide: One-handed swords are the most common weapons. They are well-balanced weapons in all their attributes. Mystics with a taste for hand-to-hand combat often carry swords and shields. This combination is particularly useful in solo hunting.

Newbie Guide: One-handed blunt weapons have a higher accuracy than other weapon, however, their chance to inflict critical damage is much lower. Blunt weapons are designed to reliably deal predictable amounts of damage . This is the reason they are the first weapons a Mystic learns. As you advance,…

Newbie Guide: Two-handed blunts weapons and two-handed swords send a message of formidable power. Two-handed blunt weapons like the Cedar Staff -- a popular weapon among Mystics -- have a relatively slow swing, but can inflict damage nearly as great as a well-armed Fighter. They also have excellent…

Newbie Guide: Dagger type weapons allow you to attack with unsurpassed speed. Furthermore, they have the greatest chance of inflicting critical damage. Their accuracy is low, however, and of course their reach is quite short. Daggers also have a very small range of random damage.

Newbie Guide: The obvious advantage of bows is their ability to deliver damage at range. There is more, though, that you should know. Bows are the slowest weapons, but they can inflict the greatest damage. Many use their bows as a backup weapon, but with proper training a bow can become your primar…
